bodyPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Rogue BODY PROPORTION correction with a locked original head and face.
Image 1 is the ONLY Rogue edit target and authoritative original face. Image 2 is the original user archer style/proportion reference. Image 3 is the current Monk proportion comparison only.
ABSOLUTE INVARIANT: retain the ENTIRE original head, face, eyes, eyebrows, smirk, mouth corner angle, brown fringe, cheek shape and hood around the face from Image 1 unchanged. Do not improve, simplify, restyle, repaint, beautify or change the expression even slightly. The user's preference depends on the exact tiny facial differences. Head stays at the SAME LOCATION AND SIZE in the 1024 x 1536 transparent canvas. Only draw or modify BELOW the neck. The original head/face pixels will be retained in final preparation, so the new neck and shoulders MUST align with the unchanged existing head.
Actual requested change: Input 1's body and limbs are too long. REDRAW the body from neck downward with a much more COMPACT ADULT CARTOON build, following Image 2's generous head-to-body relationship. Shorten torso about 15 percent and shorten the thighs/shins about 25–30 percent. Shorten arms accordingly so the hands remain proportionate to the hips, not below knees. Grounded stance, strong readable hands/boots. Keep original natural adult facial identity; no chibi/baby face and no giant new hood.
Composition is important: keep the original top/head position, but bring BOTH BOOT SOLES UP by about 300–350 original canvas pixels, so the shorter figure finishes around y=1150–1200 instead of y=1500. Leave the lower portion transparent rather than stretching anatomy to fill the portrait. This must be an actual shorter drawn body under the original head, not a scaled-down copy of the entire character.
Preserve the recognizable costume design: dark olive short hooded cloak, charcoal practical clothes, exposed rolled-sleeve forearms, one brown pouch, small rust-red waist cloth accent, wraps, substantial leather boots. Keep TWO SHORT DAGGERS IN REVERSE GRIP. Adjust lengths of hanging cloth and weapon placement to fit the shorter body. No new equipment or costume motif.
Simplify below-neck shadow shapes into a few broad purposeful flat masses following form. Large quiet areas on trousers and cloak. Avoid repeated little triangular patches, many extra tatters, microdetails, glossy rendering or flat polygon tiling. Thick expressive near-black contour and restrained earthy colors like the original archer reference. No gradient, glow, rimlight, halo, grain, dithering or coarse pixels. Keep full native drawing resolution.
ONE full body adult male Rogue only, boots and both dagger tips uncut, transparent background, no ground shadow, label, text or watermark. Highest priority: original head/face untouched; correction is neck-down only.
clothingRepairPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: LOCAL CLOTHING JOIN CLEANUP ONLY.
Image 1 is the edit target, a compact-body Rogue with his ORIGINAL FACE already restored. Image 2 is the authoritative original face reference. DO NOT repaint or move the face, skull, fringe, eye shape, smirk, head size, hood silhouette, neck position or body proportions. Preserve Image 1's shorter legs, exact pose and full composition.
Fix only the small mismatched clothing joins at the rolled beige sleeve on the viewer's LEFT upper arm, and the olive scarf/fastener area just below the neck. The left rolled sleeve currently has an obvious oddly shaped flat patch where two outlines/tones meet: make it one coherent simple rolled cuff with one base color and one broad shadow, matching the surrounding sleeve, without moving the arm. The scarf just below the original face currently has stacked jagged dark fragments: make that local collar/scarf join coherent with the original olive fabric and one clasp. No extra strap, fragment or repeated outline.
Everything else must stay as Image 1, especially the ORIGINAL FACE and body/leg proportions. Keep entire original upper head in its current pixel location. No redesign of facial features, no global style transfer or restyling. TWO reverse-grip short daggers, boots, clothing colors and original character identity remain.
Retain the 1024x1536 native transparent canvas, the shorter figure leaving clear empty space below the boots. Keep flat restrained shading, no soft gradient, glow, halo, feathered smudges or texture. No text, scenery, shadow or watermark. This is a tiny join repair on clothing below the face only.
preparation: Exact original face/forelock pixel region [560,125,215,180] restored without resampling after body generation and local clothing repair.
